notes.title: Step into a world of artisan dragons in Flamecraft!
notes.content:
[h1]After Wingspan and Quilts and Cats of Calico, we here at Monster Couch are thrilled to invite you to step into the warmth and wonder of our newest title: Flamecraft![/h1]

[h1]Wishlist now:[/h1]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3201730/Flamecraft/

Enter a cozy, magical world where artisan dragons breathe life into enchanted shops and clever strategy sparks delight at every turn.

[previewyoutube=P9_fQO9PARk;full][/previewyoutube]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35075530/313862aaae75cfc0adfb0636397f1ceee6ff6e46.png[/img]

In Flamecraft, players take turns visiting shops helping dragons find ideal homes and using enchantments to entice them to produce wondrous things. Your reputation will grow as you aid the dragons and shopkeepers, and the player with the most reputation wins.

Dragons are specialized (like: bread, meat, iron, crystal, plant and potion) and playing well relies on knowing when and where to go. You visit a shop to gain items and a favor from one of the dragons there which can also make a combo with the store's power. Gathered items can be later used to enchant a shop, gaining reputation and the favors of all the dragons in the shop. There are also ways to attract fancy dragons that give you additional opportunities to secure even more reputation.

[h1]Flamecraft features:[/h1]
[h3]A Living World of Dragons and Magic[/h3]
In this city, dragons and everyday life blend into one enchanting landscape. The baker at Guilty Treasures can’t wait to watch your dragon whip up sugary treats, while Scale Mail Post stands ready to deliver your enchanted letters. Every corner of the town hums with possibility, as artisan dragons lend their fiery talents to ignite mundane tasks, turning them into moments of magic and delight.

[h3]Play Your Way, Solo or Together[/h3]
Whether you crave a quiet afternoon of single-player strategy or a fiery multiplayer showdown, Flamecraft has you covered. Face challenging AI opponents, set up a custom game for family and friends, or try the online mode with fellow Flamekeepers. No two games will ever unfold the same way!

[h3]Strategic Resource Management and Combo Crafting[/h3]
Each turn, you’ll visit a unique shop: perhaps Gnome Depot for iron, Drake of Cakes for fresh pastries, or Draconic Tonic for bubbling concoctions. Those resources power your enchantments, which in turn fire up whole shops of dragons at once. Mastering the timing and sequence of these combos is key to outmaneuvering your rivals and racking up the reputation points you need to win.

[h3]Over 70 Dragons, 30 Shops and One Whimsical Score[/h3]
We’ve brought Sandara Tang’s exquisite art to life in a vibrant 3D sculpted town, animating over seventy charming dragons as they hone their crafts across thirty distinct shops. To complete the experience, Paweł Górniak, composer of Wingspan and Quilts and Cats of Calico, returns with a spellbinding soundtrack that will carry you through every clever twist and cozy moment. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35075530/313862aaae75cfc0adfb0636397f1ceee6ff6e46.png[/img]

[h3]If you like your dragon news freshly baked, be sure to sing up to our newsletter, and if you want to join other Flamekeepers on the official Discord channel - you're invited! Just click the below links:[/h3]

[url=https://www.monstercouch.com/flamecraft/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35075530/3cf06c73d73db4c4f2b90ef310f256fbc035cca9.png[/img][/url]

[url=https://discord.gg/QyV2yKjnjJ][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35075530/393b1936cc7dc3d50ba8da9de42eb2287cc5a520.png[/img][/url]

notes.title: September 4th patchnotes - Introducing Interface Size feature!
notes.content:
[h3]Quilters!

[b]A new patch is here![/b]

In this one we’re taking care of a handful of bugs and glitches, improving Japanese localization and adding some missing objective explanations! 

[b]We are also adding a new feature: Switching Interface Size![/b]

“Interface Size” setting introduces the option to scale UI elements such as buttons, panels, fonts, etc. There are 3 interface size options: Small, Medium, and Large, which can be selected in the Settings menu to match your preferences.

Thank you so much for your reports and feedback! Take care, stay safe and cozy, and see you soon!

[b]Please remember to update your game![/b]

Check the full patchnotes below: 

New Features:
[olist]
[*]UI Scaling - Players can choose user interface scale from 3 presets (small, medium and large) which will impact the size of the Objective window, Cat Editor, Tutorial hints and fonts.
[/olist]
Bug Fixes:
[olist]
[*] Text explanation for the "One of each cat" objective is now displayed properly.
[*] Double clicking the "Play Online" button, which caused various Online problems, is no longer possible.
[*]Improved credits rendering on low-end machines.
[*]Players can now undo tiles on gamepad in free play section of the tutorial.
[*]Players will no longer lose the ability to control their tiles when switching between boards while being in cat interaction mode.
[*]Cat editor now correctly displays which color is selected in color selection pop-ups and all of the pop-ups have proper names.
[*]Players entering the game during the game host's first turn will no longer have the possibility to change custom cats while viewing the host's board.
[*]Undo move feature in story mode will now correctly save through quit and continue.
[*]Master Quilter Challenge #17 now properly shows all objectives needed to complete the challenge.
[*]Fixed a minor clipping issue with Summer Solstice clothing.
[*]New nickname will show in Custom Game creation right after changing it in the Online menu.
[*]Green button in the credits section no longer disappears.
[*]Players will be able to join the game via Steam invite even if they didn't configure their profile yet (players will be led to the Profile creation and join the game after that).
[/olist]
Other:
[olist]
[*] Cat change option was removed from the Story Mode.
[*] Cat ears will now hide under various headwear pieces.
[*] Japanese localization improvement. 
[*] Glyphs for DualShock and DualSense controllers added.
[/olist] [/h3]

notes.title: June 13th patch notes - The Summer Solstice event is here!
notes.content:
[h2]Hi there, everyone![/h2]

We thought we’d let you know about seasonal content for Quilts and Cats of Calico. We’ve got a pretty cozy plan and we’d like to share it with you. The short story is…

[h1]Starting today, seasonal content will be coming to the game and Summer Pawstice is already here![/h1]

Throughout the year, there are plenty of beautiful, colorful, and joyful occasions around the world worth celebrating. We want to give those events some love and we want to give you an opportunity to celebrate those in the game while sewing your quilts. It just so happens that one such event is just around the corner, and [b]starting now and until July 4th, you’ll be able to revel in the mysterious charm and eerie serenity of summer, with the Summer Solstice content[/b]. In this case, though, we’re pretty sure the cats would prefer to call it the Summer Pawstice. You know what? Let’s call it that to avoid any unnecessary scratches.

[h3]What do the Seasonal Decorations Include?[/h3]
Each of the events will come with its own, unique set of decorations that will include a seasonal background, as well as a set of new decorations for the Cat Editor. The background will let you feel the unique spirit of each of the events with every quilt you sew, and the oh-so-ever rowdy felines, adorned with the new decorations, will surely prove to be a fun addition, as well.

[h2]Also, here's a trailer showcasing the new and upcoming cosmetic additions:[/h2]
[previewyoutube=FCIIbvg0FQg;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3]Which events will be celebrated?[/h3]
All around the year and all around the world, there are numerous occasions that call for celebration. And while we can’t possibly cover all of them, we chose some that we feel come together as an interesting and diverse package. Here’s the list of the events:
- Lunar New Year
- Valentine's Day
- Sakura
- Easter
- Ramadan
- Summer Solstice
- Halloween
- Christmas/Holiday

Both the backgrounds and decoration items will be available for a set amount of time, covering the corresponding celebration. And last but not least, and maybe best of all is that [b]each and every one of these updates will come as a free, temporary in-game seasonal feature![/b]

We hope you’ll celebrate all of these lovely, vibrant times of the year with us (and the cats). 

[h3]Patch notes![/h3]
Here are the details of the new features, changes and fixes mad in today's patch!

[b]New features:[/b][list]
[*] Story Mode Hint System - Players will have the ability to skip to a later stage of a puzzle or match in the story mode after failing it. There is a possibility to choose from 3 states of completion of the puzzle/match.
[*] In-game cat swapping - Players will now have the option to change cats used in the game to any of their created custom cats by clicking on cats' portraits.
[*] Story Mode - Optional mini-games are now indicated with a blue exclamation mark.
[/list]
[b]Bug Fixes:[/b][list]
[*] Objectives window is no longer missing a title in story mode games
[*] Glyph for exiting Online Challenge pop-up added
[*] Minor tweaks to props present on game boards
[*] Exiting the challenge will no longer go back to Main Menu but will instead go to Online Menu
[*] Cats will no longer be possible to pet through UI elements
[*] Game no longer freezes after achieving 99+ points
[*] Three digit points value will now be properly scaled and displayed
[*] Frank is no longer incorrectly called "Commander" in his end game puzzle
[*] Closing full tile bag view will now only happen when player presses the designated button, instead of accepting RMB (or its equivalent)
[*] Leftovers of D-pad navigation disabled
[*] Eye icon showing which board the player is looking at will now correctly display when joining an ongoing online game
[*] Minor fix to how refreshing market tiles in solo mode was working
[*] Profanity filter will now work when choosing online nickname
[*] Players will now have the ability to use various alphabets, instead of just the latin one, when choosing an online nickname
[/list]
[b]Misc:[/b][list]
[*] Photo of Cylke the Cat added to credits
[*] Small tweak to Online Challenge generation algorithm
[*] Some localization updates
[*] Pressing RMB while holding a tile will now take it back to player's hand instead of placing it back on the board
[/list]
Take care, stay safe and cozy, and see you soon!

P.S. As always, feel free to join our Discord server to chat about your strategies, high scores and more, cats included. If you feel like there’s not enough adorable cat pictures in your life, the Discord server is also the place for you.

notes.title: April 22 patch notes - weekly Challenges (and more) are here!
notes.content:
[h3]Hey, Quilters![/h3]

It’s time for the first big content patch for Quilts and Cats of Calico. We all know it’s a cozy, relaxing game, right? The purring cats, vibrant colors and soothing music can be quite calming. On the other hand, though, we know it can be a challenge, especially when the player whose turn was right before you takes the yellow flower tile which was perfect for you and you oh so wanted and oh my why did they have to ruin my perfect quilt?!

[h2]Weekly Challenges are here[/h2]
Okay, let’s calm down. Today, we want to introduce a new kind of a challenge to the game, for those who like competing in rankings and perfecting their scores on a preset board. In these weekly contests, you’ll be aiming to become (one of) the best scoring quilters and if you manage to do so, your nickname - along with your score - will be visible to players all over the world!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43309412/fc83be046ea53f64f67451e6e775522f5b9bcd09.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43309412/43e639400d5b7131a54bc2af22b316dd3c00dc43.jpg[/img]

So how do the challenges work? Each week, a system designed for this specific purrpose (sorry, we had to) is going to draw from a bag of modes, AI difficulties, goals and rules to create an exciting premade game for everyone. Next - the puzzly fun begins! You’ll be able to play the challenge however many times you want to get that fluffy high score. Since there’s no randomness, you’ll be able to get a better score with each of your attempts. At the end of the week and for the entirety of the duration of the next challenge, 6 players with the highest scores will be put on the ranking board for all other quilters to see.

The first challenge is already available, so pounce right on in!

[h2]Limited Rules, QoL changes & patch notes[/h2]

But that’s not all we’ve prepared for today. Besides the Challenge Mode, there are also a few quality of life changes we’ve made. Most of these relate to how Limited Rules are displayed during the games. Before, it could’ve been hard for players to access the information, so we’ve made it a bit easier. Here’s the rundown:
[list]
[*] We’ve added an animation showing hexes you won’t be able to place tiles on, when playing using some of the limited rules
[*] During gameplay, limited rules are now visible in a separate window you can access at any time
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43309412/340c9da77e29a521c8c222a9855ddc138f560506.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43309412/d9bc91e0ca8ae4e5e0a311c7be7c77fa72df56e1.gif[/img]

And finally, here’s the list of other changes that went live with this update:
[list]
[*] Added a pop-up informing of campaign progress loss when starting new campaign run
[*] Added a contact field to the in-game report system
[*] Some minor bug fixes
[*] Some minor visual UI and VFX fixes
[/list]

So, if you think you’ve got what it takes to become one of the quiltest cat-lovers there is, we invite you to join in on the Weekly Challenge fun! Also, feel free to join our Discord server to chat about your strategies, high scores and more, cats included. If you feel like there’s not enough adorable cat pictures in your life, the Discord server is also the place for you.

[url=https://discord.gg/quilts-and-cats-of-calico-1034094500286570508][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43309412/ab1a4ed608010f07ffe22c59e22f2b46b7e459c3.jpg[/img][/url]

We hope you enjoy this new addition to the game and we can’t wait to see you on the ranking board! 

Take care!

notes.title: The Community and Points Shop Items are here!
notes.content:
[h3]Hi there, quilters![/h3]

How are you and your quilts and cats doing? Today, we're bringing to you something that some of you waited for, especially if you're into the Steam ecosystem.

[h2]Quilts and Cats of Calico now has its own, pawsome set of Steam Community Items!
[/h2]

That's right! [b]Firstly, tarting today, you'll be able to receive Trading Cards from the game.[/b] If you're not familiar with how they work, they drop randomly after a certain amount of time spent in the game and are bound to your account. This way, you'll be able to collect half of a set, and then trade for the remaining ones to complete the full set, allowing you to craft a badge. Whether it's for personal satisfaction or bragging rights, completing a full set is no small feat!

Read more about Steam Trading Cards here: https://steamcommunity.com/tradingcards/


[b]The second exciting addition today is the Points Shop Items![/b] These items allow you to decorate your Steam profile, or expand your in-app messenger repertoire of stickers and emoji, by spending points. There's lots of coziness and cats in the set we've added and the items include:
[list]
[*] Mini-profile backgrounds
[*] Profile backgrounds
[*] Animated Stickers
[*] Emoticons
[*] Animated avatars
[*] Avatar frame
[/list]
Decorate your profile with images from the city of cat worshippers, pick a cute new avatar and surprise your friends with a peekaboo cat!

Read more about the Steam Points Shop here: https://store.steampowered.com/points/howitworks


Access the Quilts and Cats of Calico Item Shop here: https://store.steampowered.com/points/shop/app/1993180


[h3]We hope you like this small, cozy set of items. Let us know your thoughts and until next time, stay wholesome![/h3]

notes.content:
[h3]Hello Kitty Lovers!

Work on Quilts & Cats of Calico is in full swing, and it's high time to show you even more of the cozy cat world.

We invite you to the beta testing of Quilts & Cats of Calico! It will run from [b]September 19 to September 25[/b] here on Steam.

We're very keen on your feedback and on Discord we'll be the quickest to pick up and check on any information or potential issues with the game.

Hope to see you soon,
Quilts & Cats of Calico Team[/h3]

notes.title: Kitty Diary #1 - Stroking Cats
notes.content:
[h3]Hello, Quilters! Today we’re coming to you with a very first kitty diary post. This time we’d like to present you one of the features which we hope will help Quilts & Cats of Calico stand out among other digital board games.

Petting cats!

Yup, some of you already have had an opportunity to pet kitties in the demos. But for those who didn’t have a chance to do so: you can pet cats wandering around the board during your whole game![/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43309412/fa5e2b96f07dad1c32f53df5267b4255cc2bb19e.gif[/img]

[h3]While creating petting mechanics, we studied dozens of cats' moves and reactions to human touch. We used real-life shots of playing with cats to create close to realism, stylized interactions with animals. We wanted players to be able to feel close to our kitties.[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43309412/16efc48e46fe0ade59c0447bc432b971bd934826.gif[/img]

[h3]At first, which you could see in the game’s demo versions, cats were mostly standing while being petted. You will see in the future that – like in real life – cats respond differently to stroking in different positions. They will behave differently when you stroke them as they stand, sit or lie down. Our cats are unique. They will even let you rub their bellies! Below you can see the belly rub animation we are currently working on:[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43309412/4b222c755cc6f7f2abe5485280b9ed5b5ccc73ae.gif[/img]

[h3]Cats also make their specific moves while they’re being petted. They react to your touch and try to brush against you, wanting to be pet even more. You can observe it spending time with cats in Quilts & Cats of Calico.

We’ve also added one, hidden interaction with the menu kitties… but we won't reveal anything more. Just get to know one of the kitties, maybe you’ll discover it. ;)

That’s it for today’s kitty diary. Next time we’ll explore another aspect of the game, which we created especially for our Quilts & Cats of Calico version of the game. What is it exactly? You’ll find out very soon. Stay tuned![/h3]
